title.text: Budapest: Guided City Centre Electric Bike Tour

pills.label: 3.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 3.5 hours.

pills.label: 3 languages
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English, German and French.

pills.summary_html: ⚡ E-bike up Castle Hill▾
pills.pop_html: The climb: After the Chain Bridge, now closed to private cars, the route climbs Castle Hill to Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion with electric support. You still pedal: the bikes are wooden-frame my-esel or KTM Cento e-bikes.

pills.summary_html: 📍 19 stops, both banks▾
pills.pop_html: Route: Jewish Quarter, House of Terror, Heroes' Square, City Park and Vajdahunyad Castle, Andrássy Avenue, the Opera, St Stephen's Basilica, Parliament, Castle Hill, Rudas and Gellért Baths, Liberty Bridge, Central Market Hall, the National Museum and Dohány Street Synagogue. All seen from outside, no entries.
Group: Shared departures are capped at 10 participants, and the same route can be booked as a private tour. Guides speak English, German and French.
Who can ride: Not suitable for children under 13, riders under 160 cm or over 110 kg, or anyone without cycling experience. Helmets are provided but optional.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: E-bike rental; Tour guide; Helmet (optional).Not included: Hotel pick-up and drop-off; Tips; Food and drinks.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want Buda and Pest in one ride without sweating up Castle Hill, because the motor handles the climb and the loop covers 19 stops in 3.5 hours.
best_for.skip_html: if you are under 160 cm, over 110 kg or have never ridden a bike in traffic: the e-bike tour at #3 lists no height or weight limit.

items.a: Bike & Relax, Madách Imre út 12, 1075 Budapest.
Under 13, under 160 cm, over 110 kg, no cycling experience.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. The final price shows before you pay.

pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.

pills.label: 12+ only
pills.pop_html: 🎟️ Kids: ✕ not suitable for children under 12⚠️ Not suitable for: pregnant women

pills.summary_html: 🏰 Castle Hill + Margaret Island▾
pills.pop_html: Buda side: Ride Duna Corso to Elizabeth Bridge, climb the Castle District for a 25-minute stop with free time and the Fisherman's Bastion view, then drop to Margaret Bridge for a 20-minute break on Margaret Island.
Included: Bike, helmet, live guide, a bottle of mineral water, sunscreen and a clean toilet at the start office. Tips are extra.
Same route: The same route and timetable is also sold as an e-bike tour from the same meeting point, for €50. The €12 difference buys electric help on the Castle Hill climb.

pills.summary_html: 🕒 Andrássy if time permits▾
pills.pop_html: Pest finale: After Parliament, Liberty Square and St Stephen's Basilica, the ride continues down Andrássy Avenue past the Opera and House of Terror to Heroes' Square and City Park only if time permits. Those stops are marked optional.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Bike; Live guide; A bottle of mineral water; Helmet; Sunscreen.Not included: Tips.

best_for.pick_html: for riders happy to pedal who want Castle Hill and Margaret Island, because €12.67 an hour is the lowest price per hour of any tour here that guarantees the Buda climb.
best_for.skip_html: if pedalling uphill puts you off: Castle Hill is a real climb on a classic bike, so take #1 or the €50 e-bike version of this route (#3).

items.a: Bike, helmet, live guide, bottle of mineral water, sunscreen, clean toilet.

pills.label: 2.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 2.5 hours.

pills.summary_html: 🌳 Flat, on bike lanes▾
pills.pop_html: Terrain: Pest only, mostly on cycle lanes: Liberty Square, Shoes on the Danube Bank, Parliament, Andrássy Avenue, Heroes' Square, a walk into City Park and Vajdahunyad Castle, Széchenyi Thermal Bath and the Zoo.
Languages: One of two bike tours here with guides beyond English. The route passes Nagymező utca, the theatre and bar street, and guides share night-out tips there.
Who can ride: Not suitable under 8, the lowest bike age on this page. No strollers, luggage or large bags.
Finish: Starts at Szent István tér 4 by St Stephen's Basilica and returns through the old streets past the Dohány Street Synagogue, with 3 drop-off locations.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Personal guide; Bike; Helmet.

best_for.pick_html: for families with kids aged 8 to 12 and anyone who wants a flat, low-stress ride, because it sticks to Pest bike lanes and costs €33.
best_for.skip_html: if you want Buda views from the top: it never climbs to the Castle District.
